ui_bugs.component: OnboardingPage step 4 (heard) — Skip link vs Cookie banner
ui_bugs.issue: Cookie consent banner (fixed bottom, z-9999) overlaps and intercepts pointer events for the [data-testid='heard-skip'] text link at 1440x900. The banner's outer wrapper is pointer-events-none but the inner card 'p-5 sm:p-6' intercepts. Users on a fresh session (banner not dismissed) cannot click the small text-only Skip link. Card grid buttons (heard-youtube..heard-other) are above the banner and work fine.

issues: Skip link is a small muted text link far below 12 card grid — inconsistent with other steps (WladHub uses full-width outline button, Call step uses same muted-text style so this is consistent with Call). Consider promoting Skip to a subtle button to avoid cookie-banner overlap.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider auto-dismissing cookie banner on /onboarding route (post-login) or raising Skip link above banner z-index; card clicks unaffected so this is low priority — user can still complete flow via card click or by dismissing banner first.
critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingPage.js line 26: initial `heard_from: ''` in data state — sends empty string when Skip is clicked; backend correctly handles because `if data.heard_from` is falsy for empty string, so no overwrite. Verified via test_onboarding_without_heard_from + Flow 2 verification (heard_from remains NOT_SET). OK.
